description: Classes for facts.user_agent_class, computed in code from the HTTP user agent (an untrusted field). The value is lowercased and cut to max_input_chars, then tested against each class in order; the first class with a matching pattern wins. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions without flags. A user agent is whatever the client chose to send, so the class names say `claims_`: the class is what the client says it is, not proof. `embedded_text` comes first so that a user agent carrying prose is never reported as an ordinary class.

classes.description: No user agent, or a placeholder
Longer than max_plain_chars, or contains words aimed at a reader rather than a server
Injection syntax inside the user agent
Names an uptime or monitoring service
Names a search-engine or other crawler
An HTTP library or command-line client
Looks like a desktop or mobile browser
